output.summary: A and B are the strongest: both deliver five complete, brand-safe briefs with correct stock math, conservative stock-aware spending, and explicit caveats that the existing creative and CTR observations are not proof. D is also strong and numerically careful, but has a minor audience/stock inconsistency in Brief 2. C has good arithmetic and a useful stock-protection budget shift, but includes unsupported product-fit and shipping-processing claims, and its Daypack pause guardrail does not fully address the 6/day sustainable stock rate.
